column1: # S31 again: the first had a crossbar through the middle of its blade.

column2: An ancient Bronze Age Colchian sword cast in bronze: a leaf-shaped double-edged blade with a raised midrib, a short crescent-shaped bronze guard where the blade meets the grip, a grip wrapped in red-brown leather, a round bronze disc pommel at the end of the grip. Nothing crosses the blade. A single one-handed sword, full length, no scabbard, no stand.
